item.title: Meowdoro 0.1.25
item.description: • No night of overtime on your iPhone. Its Lock Screen card shows a break's overtime for half an hour, then goes, even with your Mac asleep, and comes back when you press Start. A focus's overtime or a pause stays until the set starts over after 4 hours, as on the Mac, and then your iPhone starts over too. Meowdoro for iPhone is in testing now: to try it, write to [meow@meowdoro.com](mailto:meow@meowdoro.com).
